name: Shaolin Monk
subtitle: Ascetic Warrior
description: Strike swift with martial prowess against heroes aligned with Chaos.
lore: These ascetic warriors follow an intricate combination of spiritual and martial practices dating back countless centuries. While the monks would prefer to be left alone in their ornate monasteries, pursuing education and enlightenment, when attacked or roused to defend others they swiftly become deadly adversaries. Ever more frequently since the Shattering, they must rise to the defense of Tian as a whole.
divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: When taking damage, has a 30% chance to reduce the damage by 20%.

skills.name: Exploding Charge
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy. If the target is aligned with Chaos then increase the damage inflicted by 30%.

skills.name: Lotus Strike
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy. If the target is defeated, Place [mechanic:sharpen-i] on this hero for 2 turns.

skills.name: Staff of Fury
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 35% chance to increase this hero’s Divinity by [25]. Place [mechanic:init-up-i] on this hero for 2 turns if the target is aligned with Chaos.
